coordinates: All mesh/sample coordinates and normals are global ZYX; distances in voxels

interpretation.boundary_chains: Maximal nonbranching paths of boundary edges whose two endpoints are in the original inclusive plane band; isolated samples retained; branch vertices can occur in several chains
interpretation.components: Surface components connect faces by shared indexed edges. Boundary components use the full indexed boundary graph before seam-band restriction.
interpretation.normal_coherence: Magnitude of incident area-vector sum divided by sum of magnitudes; low coherence makes a vertex normal uncertain
interpretation.roi_near: Within 2 voxels of first/last ROI voxel-center plane; artificial-zero proximity, not an anatomical edge
interpretation.remote_context_near: Either source or closest point within 4 voxels of left last-context X or right first-context X; absent 3-slice remote context is a hypothesis, not a causal finding
interpretation.stronger_support: >=3 samples, all distances<=4, both ownership offsets<=2, all normal coherence>=0.8 and abs dot>=0.9, >=50% reciprocal band-vertex matches, one target chain, no ROI/context/branch hints. Descriptive only; no weld authorization.
interpretation.ct: Exact raw crop checked against frozen real CT; pred checked against exclusive >126. Foreground supports local intensity only; no labels, fiber tracking or sheet correspondence.
interpretation.step7: Hashes, retention and guards are reused as provenance. Closest geometry is final owned mesh, not overlapping pretrim halos.
interpretation.not_repeated: No remeshing, native audit, coverage evaluation, or v2/v4 duplicate run. New per-sample query cache prevents future repeated point/triangle work.

post_weld_validation_plan: Preserve this original two-core sample set and hashes. Never choose new correspondences solely from post-weld proximity.
Require a face/vertex provenance map for output; certify original oriented source faces or explicitly account for every changed/removed source face.
Check exact duplicates, degeneracy, edge/manifold/orientation guards and native all-face overlap/stab/fold audit on the actual saved welded output.

Keep directional 25/34 baseline against the opposite owned core. Never measure against the complete union: own incident faces make this distance trivially zero. If opposite-owner geometry changes, query only that changed geometry.

Separately measure added seam-face support, residual seam boundary edges and connected paths between original owners. Zero point-to-new-face distance can be true by construction and is not a recovery/identity certificate.
Report newly added seam faces by original chain pair, geometric displacement, CT support, near-ROI/context flags and normal ambiguity. Zero intersections alone does not certify sheet identity.
Inspect real-CT slices at accepted and rejected seam chains and document uncertain fiber continuity; do not infer anatomic identity from Otsu support or labels.
